decisions.reason: The reusable citrus harvesting crate builds on the firm's existing crate and agricultural packaging expertise.
The foldable large container is a natural extension of the firm's container knowledge and in-house engineering.
The stackable plastic crate is highly related to the firm's core plastic crate and packaging capabilities.
The medium-duty rackable pallet leverages the firm's existing pallet design and manufacturing knowledge.
The spill-retention pallet, while more specialized, still builds on pallet and design expertise supported by R&D.
The plastic pallet with load retainers integrates with existing pallet and handling accessory know-how.
